3. How do you manage your budget and avoid overspending when shopping?
title: Topic 1: Shopping & Spending Habits
content:
1. How often do you go shopping for clothes or daily necessities?
2. Do you prefer shopping online or going to physical stores? Why?
3. How do you manage your budget and avoid overspending when shopping?

questions.answer: I buy daily necessities like food once a week, while I only shop for clothes once every two months.
questions.example: On Sunday mornings, I usually go to a nearby supermarket with my mom to buy groceries for the whole week.
questions.q: How often do you go shopping for clothes or daily necessities?
questions.reason: Buying only when needed helps me save money and avoid wasting time, though shopping with friends sometimes helps me relax and elevate my mood.

questions.answer: I prefer going to physical stores for clothes, even though online shopping is fast and convenient for busy people.
questions.example: Last month, I went to a local clothing shop near my house to try on a jacket before buying it.
questions.q: Do you prefer shopping online or going to physical stores? Why?
questions.reason: Shopping on e-commerce apps often tempts buyers to waste money on cheap items that look nothing like the advertised photos, whereas in stores I can check quality directly.

questions.answer: I always make a shopping list before going out and set a clear spending limit each month.
questions.example: Before visiting the supermarket, I write down exact food items on my phone and avoid buying unnecessary snacks.
questions.q: How do you manage your budget and avoid overspending when shopping?
questions.reason: This helps me stay on the safe side, think things through calmly, and choose items that fit comfortably within my budget.

reusedVocab: tempts buyers to waste money on cheap items that look nothing like the advertised photos
stay on the safe side and think things through calmly

content:

3. What qualities do you think are most essential in a lifelong friend?

questions.answer: I love both, but I prefer spending my leisure time with my family because my family means the world to me.
questions.example: On weekends, I usually stay at home to have dinner and talk with my parents instead of going out late.
questions.q: Do you prefer spending your leisure time with family or with friends?
questions.reason: My family loves me unconditionally, and spending quality time together helps strengthen bonds within the family and makes me feel peaceful.

questions.answer: My family enjoys both indoor and outdoor activities like cooking meals, watching movies, and going on a picnic.
questions.example: Last Sunday, we prepared a big lunch together at home and watched a comedy movie in the living room.
questions.q: What activities do you usually enjoy doing together with your family?
questions.reason: Doing these activities allows us to openly and respectfully share our thoughts and emotions, relieve stress, and feel over the moon together.

questions.answer: I think honesty, kindness, and being supportive are the most essential qualities in a lifelong friend.
questions.example: My best friend from high school always gives me honest advice and supports me whenever I feel down.
questions.q: What qualities do you think are most essential in a lifelong friend?
questions.reason: A good friend is someone who is always beside you when you face difficulties, listens patiently, and has a lot of things in common with you.

title: Part 3 - Topic 1: The Importance of Teamwork in Modern Life
content:
Topic: The vital importance of teamwork in work and study
Suggestions:
- Boosting productivity and sharing heavy workloads
- Combining diverse skills, knowledge, and creative ideas
- Developing mutual trust, communication, and conflict resolution skills

Follow-up questions:
1. Why do some individuals prefer working independently rather than in a team?
2. How can a team leader effectively resolve disagreements between team members?
3. What soft skills are most critical for successful teamwork in modern workplaces?

hint.coreTopic: the importance of teamwork in work and study

followUps.answer: There are some reasons why some people prefer working alone, such as wanting quiet time and full control over their schedule.
followUps.example: For example, a designer or writer may work faster at home without waiting for slow teammates to reply.
followUps.q: Why do some individuals prefer working independently rather than in a team?
followUps.reason: This is because working in noisy groups can cause stress or disagreements, while working alone gives them peace, privacy, and freedom to follow their own pace.

followUps.answer: I think a team leader should stay calm, listen to every side fairly, and focus on solving the problem.
followUps.example: For instance, if two coworkers argue about a marketing plan, the leader can hold a short meeting to combine the best ideas from both sides.
followUps.q: How can a team leader effectively resolve disagreements between team members?
followUps.reason: This helps everyone stay on the safe side, avoid unnecessary trouble, and understand each other better through face-to-face interaction.

followUps.answer: There are some key soft skills for teamwork, such as active listening, clear communication, and time management.
followUps.example: For example, team members who update their progress daily help the group finish a company report smoothly.
followUps.formula: What -> There are some [Ns], such as...
followUps.q: What soft skills are most critical for successful teamwork in modern workplaces?
followUps.reason: This is because good communication prevents misunderstandings, and meeting deadlines keeps the whole team productive and stress-free.

mindmapPoints.cue: Boosting productivity and sharing heavy workloads
mindmapPoints.expand: This is because each member takes care of one small part of a big project, so the team can finish tasks on time and reduce stress.
mindmapPoints.impact: Therefore, it is good for mental health and helps workers reach a healthy balance between work and rest.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Teamwork helps people boost productivity and share heavy workloads.

mindmapPoints.cue: Combining diverse skills, knowledge, and creative ideas
mindmapPoints.expand: For example, in a class project, one student can design slides, another writes the report, and everyone learns new things from each other.
mindmapPoints.impact: Clearly, it is beneficial to both students and office workers.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Working in a team helps members share different skills, knowledge, and creative ideas.

mindmapPoints.cue: Developing mutual trust, communication, and conflict resolution skills
mindmapPoints.expand: This is because working closely with others teaches us how to listen calmly, share ideas politely, and solve problems together.
mindmapPoints.impact: So, it has positive effects on our social network and workplace relationships.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Teamwork helps people build trust, communication, and problem-solving skills.

title: Topic 3: Dream Job & Career Aspirations
content:

2. What qualifications or skills do you need to achieve your dream career?
3. In your opinion, is job passion or a high salary more important when choosing a lifelong job?

questions.answer: When I was a child, my dream job was to be a teacher, though it has changed over time to working in business.
questions.example: I am currently studying marketing at university and doing a part-time office internship to prepare for this career.
questions.q: 1. Childhood dream job & whether it changed
questions.reason: As I grew up, I realized I want a job that can improve my living standard and let me gain knowledge in a fast-paced environment.

questions.answer: To achieve my dream career, I need a university degree, good English communication, and practical computer skills.
questions.example: For example, I am taking an evening English course for a B2 certificate and practicing teamwork skills in group projects.
questions.q: 2. Qualifications or skills needed for your dream career
questions.reason: Nowadays, employers want workers who can keep pace with modern technology, solve daily problems, and learn new skills continuously.

questions.answer: In my opinion, job passion is slightly more important, though we still need a decent salary to live comfortably.
questions.example: For instance, a friend of mine earns a high salary at a bank, but he feels exhausted and has no time for family or hobbies.
questions.reason: Doing a job you love helps reduce stress and elevate your mood every day, whereas chasing only high pay often leads to fatigue.

group: Đề thi thực tế UFM 15/11/2026 (Chiều - Ca 1)
title: Part 2 - Situation 2: Prioritizing Hospital Upgrades and Improvements
content:
Situation: A local general hospital has received municipal funding to improve its operations. The management board is considering three areas to prioritize:
- Modernizing advanced medical equipment (nâng cấp trang thiết bị y tế hiện đại)
- Improving customer care and patient services (nâng cao chất lượng dịch vụ chăm sóc người bệnh)
- Expanding physical infrastructure and hospital beds (mở rộng cơ sở vật chất và giường bệnh)
Which option do you think is the best choice and why?

chosen.khen1Text: because a modern hospital with state-of-the-art machines and high-tech labs gives doctors and nurses the best conditions to examine and treat patients accurately.

khen2ARE.answer: This option brings local residents a wide range of benefits because it is beneficial to people's physical health and raises public awareness of a healthy lifestyle and diseases.
khen2ARE.example: For example, if the hospital upgrades its X-ray and blood-testing machines, local patients can get quick and accurate checkups right in their town instead of traveling to big cities.
khen2ARE.reason: To be more specific, modern medical equipment helps doctors detect illnesses early and solve the problem of slow or inaccurate test results, allowing patients to recover faster and stay healthy.

chosen.khen3Text: great for reducing mental pressure for both doctors and patients. This is because accurate equipment keeps treatment under control, allowing everyone to feel safe, confident, and emotionally balanced.

rejected.option: Expanding physical infrastructure and hospital beds
rejected.reason: constructing new buildings and adding more hospital beds costs too much money and takes years to finish, which can burden the city's budget while leaving doctors without modern tools.

rejected.option: Improving customer care and patient services
rejected.reason: while polite staff and good service are helpful, friendliness alone cannot cure serious illnesses without proper medical machines, so this opinion has received little agreement in similar situations.

reusedVocab: raise public awareness of healthy lifestyle and diseases
feel safe, confident, and emotionally balanced

title: Part 3 - Topic 2: Benefits of Educational Technology in Schools
content:
Topic: The substantial benefits of integrating modern technology into education
Suggestions:
- Enhancing student engagement and interactive learning
- Providing quick access to diverse digital learning materials
- Facilitating distance learning and personalized study paces
- [Your own ideas]

Follow-up questions:
1. Can educational technology completely replace traditional classroom teachers in the future?
2. What are the potential drawbacks of students relying too heavily on digital devices for study?
3. How can schools ensure equal technology access for students from underprivileged backgrounds?

hint.coreTopic: the benefits of modern technology in schools

followUps.answer: No, I don't think technology can completely replace traditional teachers in the future.
followUps.example: For instance, when a young child feels sad or confused about math, a human teacher can notice right away and encourage them kindly.
followUps.formula: Do you think / Can -> No, I don't think...
followUps.q: Can educational technology completely replace traditional classroom teachers in the future?
followUps.reason: This is because teachers give emotional care, proper guidance, and real face-to-face interaction that a computer screen cannot provide.

followUps.answer: There are some drawbacks of using digital devices too much, such as eye strain, poor focus, and less outdoor activity.
followUps.example: For example, students who study on phones late at night often feel tired in class the next morning.
followUps.formula: What -> There are some [Ns], such as...
followUps.q: What are the potential drawbacks of students relying too heavily on digital devices for study?
followUps.reason: This is because too much screen time can harm physical health, hurt our eyes from blue light, and reduce real communication with classmates.

followUps.answer: I think schools and authorities should invest public funds to upgrade school computer labs and lend free laptops to poor students.
followUps.example: For example, a high school can open a free library room with Wi-Fi and computers for students to use after class.
followUps.q: How can schools ensure equal technology access for students from underprivileged backgrounds?
followUps.reason: From a broader perspective, providing financial support and free public facilities ensures every student can keep pace with modern education.

mindmapPoints.cue: Enhancing student engagement and interactive learning
mindmapPoints.expand: This is because classrooms equipped with modern teaching tools and videos make lessons fun and allow students' brains to exercise creatively.
mindmapPoints.impact: Therefore, it is good for students' motivation and helps improve learning quality.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Using technology in schools helps students feel more interested and active in class.

mindmapPoints.cue: Providing quick access to diverse digital learning materials

mindmapPoints.impact: Clearly, it is beneficial to students who want to gain more knowledge.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Educational technology helps students quickly find many useful online study materials.

mindmapPoints.cue: Facilitating distance learning and personalized study paces
mindmapPoints.expand: This is because students can join online courses from home without heavy traffic and replay difficult lessons at their own speed.
mindmapPoints.impact: So, it has positive effects on both full-time students and working learners.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Modern technology makes distance learning fast and convenient for busy students.

questions.answer: I usually prefer working on group assignments rather than doing tasks completely alone.
questions.example: Last semester, my four-person group divided a marketing presentation into small parts and finished it two days before the deadline.
questions.reason: This is because teamwork is good for my social network and lets me meet like-minded classmates, share ideas, and reduce stress on big projects.

questions.answer: I think an effective and reliable team member should be supportive, responsible, and a good listener.
questions.example: For example, my close classmate always checks our group chat every evening and helps others fix mistakes before submission.
questions.q: 2. Qualities of an effective and reliable team member
questions.reason: When everyone finishes their part on time and openly shares thoughts, it builds trust and helps the whole team work smoothly.

questions.answer: When disagreements happen in a team, I always try to stay calm and listen to everyone's opinions.
questions.example: During a recent group project, two teammates argued about the slide design, so we voted fairly and combined the best ideas from both.

title: Part 3 - Topic 3: Ways to Maintain a Healthy Lifestyle
content:
Topic: Practical ways to cultivate and maintain a healthy lifestyle
Suggestions:
- Eating a nutritious and well-balanced daily diet
- Doing regular physical exercise and workouts
- Managing emotional stress and maintaining sufficient sleep
- [Your own ideas]

Follow-up questions:
1. Why do many young people nowadays struggle to maintain a healthy lifestyle?
2. Is fast food advertising partly responsible for declining public health?

hint.coreTopic: practical ways to maintain a healthy lifestyle

followUps.answer: There are some reasons why many young people find it hard to stay healthy, such as busy schedules and bad daily habits.
followUps.example: For example, many office workers sit at a desk for eight hours and order fried chicken instead of cooking fresh food at home.
followUps.q: Why do many young people nowadays struggle to maintain a healthy lifestyle?
followUps.reason: In today's hectic world, young workers often eat fast food to save time and stay up late using phones, which hurts both their physical and mental health.

followUps.answer: Yes, I think fast food ads play a part in causing health problems.
followUps.example: For instance, bright burger ads on social media often make teenagers order sugary drinks late at night.
followUps.formula: Do you think / Is -> Yes, I think...
followUps.q: Is fast food advertising partly responsible for declining public health?
followUps.reason: This is because colorful ads tempt children and busy people to buy cheap, oily food instead of healthy meals, especially when they lack self-control.

followUps.answer: I think schools and communities should build free public sports centers and run campaigns to raise public awareness of healthy lifestyles.
followUps.example: For example, local neighborhoods can organize free morning yoga or walking clubs in the community park every weekend.
followUps.q: What can schools and local communities do to promote physical well-being among citizens?
followUps.reason: When authorities invest in safe parks and sports clubs, citizens can easily exercise together and improve their living standard.

mindmapPoints.sentence: Eating healthy and balanced meals every day plays an essential role in keeping fit.

mindmapPoints.cue: Doing regular physical exercise and workouts

mindmapPoints.impact: Clearly, it is beneficial to people of all ages.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Doing regular exercise helps people get into good shape and stay healthy.

mindmapPoints.cue: Managing emotional stress and maintaining sufficient sleep

mindmapPoints.impact: So, it has positive effects on our daily mood and work productivity.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Managing stress and sleeping enough helps people protect their mental health.

title: Topic 5: Job Interviews & Preparation
content:
1. Have you ever attended a formal job interview or scholarship interview?
2. What essential preparations should a candidate make before an interview?
3. What practical advice would you give to someone attending their first interview?

questions.answer: Yes, I attended a formal interview last year when I applied for a part-time assistant position at a language center.
questions.example: The manager asked me about my communication skills and schedule for about twenty minutes, and I got the job two days later.
questions.q: 1. Ever attended a formal job or scholarship interview?
questions.reason: At first I felt nervous, but the interview gave me valuable real-world experience and helped me understand what employers look for.

questions.answer: Before an interview, a candidate should research the company carefully, prepare clear answers, and choose neat clothes.
questions.example: For instance, I always read the company website the night before and practice answering common questions in front of a mirror.
questions.reason: Preparing well helps us stay on the safe side, gain confidence, and show that we are serious about the job.

questions.answer: My practical advice for first-time interviewees is to arrive fifteen minutes early, stay calm, and be honest.
questions.example: For example, if you do not know an answer, just smile politely and explain that you are eager to learn new skills on the job.
questions.q: 3. Practical advice for someone's first interview
questions.reason: Arriving early helps reduce stress and gives you quiet time to relax your mind, so you can speak naturally and clearly.

title: Part 2 - Situation 4: Choosing an Internship Preparation Workshop for Students
content:
Situation: Your university is organizing a special preparatory workshop for senior students who are about to start their internships. The student union is deciding between three workshop themes:
- Professional CV writing skills (kỹ năng viết CV chuyên nghiệp)
- Job interview techniques and mock interviews (kỹ năng phỏng vấn tuyển dụng)
- Workplace adaptability and communication skills (kỹ năng thích ứng với môi trường làm việc)
Which option do you think is the best choice and why?

chosen.khen1Text: because a practical workshop with interactive group activities gives senior students the best conditions to practice hands-on workplace skills before joining real companies.

khen2ARE.answer: This workshop is good for senior students' social skills and helps them adjust and adapt to the social environment at work.
khen2ARE.example: For example, during the workshop, seniors can role-play how to ask a manager for feedback or handle teamwork disagreements politely during their first week as an intern.
khen2ARE.reason: Many fresh graduates struggle at first because university lessons focus too much on theory instead of real company internships. Practicing communication helps students build a strong sense of belonging and understand colleagues through face-to-face interaction.

chosen.khen3Text: a safe and practical environment to gain real working confidence, learn teamwork habits, and get ready for a stable career.

rejected.reason: spending an entire workshop on CV writing is boring and unnecessary because senior students can easily download free CV templates online in ten minutes.

rejected.option: Job interview techniques and mock interviews
rejected.reason: interview tips only help for a short meeting before getting hired rather than during a multi-month internship, so this opinion has received little agreement among senior students.

reusedVocab: adjust and adapt to the social environment
focus too much on theory instead of real company internships
build a strong sense of belonging
build confidence, and get ready for a stable career
hint.situation: My university is organizing a special preparatory workshop for senior students who are about to start their internships. The student union is deciding between three workshop themes: professional CV writing skills, job interview techniques and mock interviews, and workplace adaptability and communication skills.

Nội dung chi tiết:
Topic: The notable drawbacks and risks of using Artificial Intelligence (AI) in education
Suggestions:
- Deteriorating students' critical thinking and problem-solving abilities
- Increasing academic dishonesty and plagiarism in assignments
- Creating overdependence on technology and diminishing face-to-face communication
- [Your own ideas]

Follow-up questions:
1. How can educators prevent students from misusing generative AI tools in coursework?
2. Do you believe AI will eventually make some academic degrees redundant?
3. What ethical guidelines should students follow when utilizing AI for research?

title: Part 3 - Topic 4: Drawbacks of Relying on Artificial Intelligence in Learning
content:
Topic: The notable drawbacks and risks of using Artificial Intelligence (AI) in education
Suggestions:
- Deteriorating students' critical thinking and problem-solving abilities
- Increasing academic dishonesty and plagiarism in assignments
- Creating overdependence on technology and diminishing face-to-face communication
- [Your own ideas]

Follow-up questions:
1. How can educators prevent students from misusing generative AI tools in coursework?
2. Do you believe AI will eventually make some academic degrees redundant?

hint.coreTopic: the drawbacks of using Artificial Intelligence (AI) in learning

followUps.answer: I think teachers should set stricter rules for homework and give more in-class speaking tests or group presentations.
followUps.example: For example, after students submit an essay, the teacher can ask them to explain their main ideas aloud in front of the class.
followUps.q: How can educators prevent students from misusing generative AI tools in coursework?
followUps.reason: This is because clear rules and heavy penalties stop cheating, while face-to-face presentations force students to truly understand their own work.

followUps.answer: No, I don't think AI will make all university degrees useless, though some simple jobs may change.
followUps.example: For instance, hospitals still need trained doctors and nurses with medical degrees to care for patients safely.
followUps.formula: Do you think -> No, I don't think...
followUps.q: Do you believe AI will eventually make some academic degrees redundant?
followUps.reason: This is because degrees prove that graduates have real knowledge, practical skills, and the ability to work with people, which AI cannot fully replace.

followUps.answer: There are some important rules students should follow, such as using AI only to brainstorm ideas and always checking facts carefully.
followUps.example: For example, a student can ask AI to explain a hard topic, then read real books and write the report in their own words.
followUps.formula: What -> There are some [Ns], such as... + Penalize self-discipline
followUps.q: What ethical guidelines should students follow when utilizing AI for research?
followUps.reason: Students must build good self-discipline, stay honest, and never copy AI text as their own work.

mindmapPoints.cue: Deteriorating students' critical thinking and problem-solving abilities
mindmapPoints.expand: This is because when students ask AI to solve every homework task, they do not allow their brain to exercise or think deeply.
mindmapPoints.impact: Therefore, it has a negative effect on their real learning and future job skills.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Using AI too much can weaken students' thinking and problem-solving skills.

mindmapPoints.cue: Increasing academic dishonesty and plagiarism in assignments
mindmapPoints.expand: For example, some lazy learners copy whole essays directly from an AI tool without writing a single sentence by themselves.
mindmapPoints.impact: Clearly, it is harmful to honest students and fair grading in schools.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Relying on AI easily leads to cheating and copying in school assignments.

mindmapPoints.cue: Creating overdependence on technology and diminishing face-to-face communication
mindmapPoints.expand: This is because students prefer chatting with AI apps instead of asking teachers or discussing lessons with classmates, which can lead to isolation.
mindmapPoints.impact: So, it has negative effects on their social network and teamwork skills.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Depending too much on AI reduces face-to-face communication among students.

hint.ownIdea: I think that 3 ideas are comprehensive. I cannot think of other ideas.

title: Part 2 - Situation 5: Choosing a Place to Take Your 10-Year-Old Niece Out
content:
Situation: You have promised to take your 10-year-old niece out for a fun day this weekend. There are three options:
- An amusement park
- A science and history museum
- A local zoo

Which option do you think is the best choice and why?

chosen.khen1Text: because it is easy to get to, so my 10-year-old niece and I can walk around, share good snacks, and chat comfortably without any complicated preparation.

khen2ARE.answer: Visiting a local zoo is beneficial to our physical health and gives my niece a great chance to increase knowledge about nature.
khen2ARE.example: For example, we can walk around the park to see elephants and giraffes while reading the animal signs and taking a few breaks in the shade.
khen2ARE.reason: Walking outdoors helps us stay active and feel more energetic, while seeing real animals up close helps a 10-year-old broaden her mind and learn how to care for wildlife.

chosen.khen3Text: the best way to help both of us forget about school and work pressure, refresh our minds, and take meaningful photos together.

rejected.reason: tickets and food at an amusement park cost too much money, and waiting in long queues or going on thrilling rides in hot weather can be unsafe and exhausting for a 10-year-old child.
a quiet museum often feels too stiff for a young child, so my niece cannot move around or talk freely and may quickly get bored on her weekend off.

reusedVocab: share good food and chat comfortably without any complicated preparation
forget about ... pressure, refresh our minds, and take meaningful photos together
feel stiff and cannot talk as freely
hint.situation: I have promised to take my 10-year-old niece out for a fun day this weekend, and I am considering three options: an amusement park, a science and history museum, or a local zoo.
